content.text: Chartist, Newton-style (simulated): Price is at 202.82, just below the 200-day average of 204.28, which is now acting as overhead resistance on any bounce. Next support below is the 60-day low at 207.25... already broken, so the next reference is the 52-week low at 164.27, a big gap. Watch prior day low 212.08 on a retest. RSI14 at 33.9 shows downside momentum but not yet extreme. DeMark daily buy setup is only 1 of 9, so an exhaustion signal is far off. Weekly buy setup is further along at 3 of 9. What would change the view: a daily close back above 213.66 (prior close) or progress in the DeMark counts toward 9, which would flag exhaustion.
